snippet.title: Dragon Dinner - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Add to Wishlist in steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4148630/Dragon_Dinner/ 

Dragon Dinner is a cozy-but-hectic restaurant simulator where you play as the waiter in a fast paced and cute dragon restaurant! Set tables, attend hungry dragons, ask plates to the kitchen, serve correct meals and clean up. After each day, customize the layout of the restaurant and learn new abilities to improve.

🎵 Music by: Madness in The Office by Rafael Krux (orchestralis.net)
